content: Yesumi Ateŋa Lenge DokonaMana Lamaiya

Yuu mendepa Yesu yuu mendasa ateŋa lao peteya. Lao otapeyamo dokopa banya disaepole mende baa piso soo, Kamongo Joneme banya disaepole dupwa ateŋa lenge dokona mana lamaiyamo doko suu pyao embame namwa mana langipi leya.
Dokopa baame nakama dopa lamaiya. Nakama ateŋa lalana dokopa dopa lao lalapape.

content.text: Rakane, embena kingi doko poo pyasi ingyuo palenale.
Embena isingi yulu doko epo palenale.
Yuu peparae namwa nenge napengele dupwa joo karape.
Wambu namwa kando koo pyakange dupwa
namwa nyuo kame sakamipala kaenge doko suu pyao
namwame koo pyakao karenge dupwa embame nyuo kame sakao karape.
Embame namwa makande pirali dupwana lanyuo paa napipi.

content: Lapala Yesumi nakama dopa lamaiya. Nakama petaminyi dokona mendeme kukwa andasukulya dokopa nakamana puu minyingi dokona anda dokona papala baa dopa lamamiyuo, Yangone, borete rema jelase.

Nambana puu minyingi mende kata papyuo ipyamo dokome nenge daapyasa saka nalyo larami ramo dokopa baame andakare palyuo isingi lao, Embame angalyi pyuo laa napipi. Kambu upi laro karamo. Nambana wane wanakepe dupwa role pyao luu palamano. Namba sipurapala bange mende emba kapa jii naro laramo dokopa apa pirami?
Dokona ingyuo pii mende langilyu, Baa embena puu minyingi dokome sipurapala jii nara ramo doko emba elya nao piso sepa sepa pyuo kararene dokona lao sipurapala kapa jera ingilyamo.
Dokona suu pyao dopa langilyu, Piso selapape. Dokopa nakama jera. Kotarami dokopa kando nyerami. Kambu dowa dokona kapa kapa pipwape. Dokome kambu lumbwakara.
Piso serami dupwa peparaeme kapa nyerami. Kotarami dupwame kando nyerami. Kambu dowa dokona kapa kapa pirami dupwana lao kambu lumbwakamira.
Nakama wane mandenge dupwame ikinyingimi oma mende jinya lara ramo dokopa oma kaepala mee kau koo mairamipi?
Panda kola kapa jinya lara ramo dokopa kau popokyalya mairamipi?

Dokona suu pyao nakama koo ingyuo petaminyi dupwame nakamana wane wanakepe dupwa bange keyange maingi doko suu pyao Rakane yake panda dokona keyange wakasa karamo dokome wambu Imambu Poo Pyasi jinya lao piso serami dupwa eŋa nembapala mai narase? leya.
Yesu Belesapulu Satane Dokope
Baame yuu mendepa imambu koo pii laa nange mende raka lanyi nembo kareya. Imambu koo doko yaki nyuo peyamo dokopa akali pii laa nange dokome pii leyasa wambu dupwame ayaka lao mona nembeyami.
Mona nembeyaminyipape nakama kareyami dupwana lapome dopa leyami. Belesapulu imambu koo dupwana kamongo dokome baa minyapyamo dokome imambu koo dupwa raka lanyi nembo karamo leyami.
Dopa lao kareyaminyi dokopa lapome Yesu baa makande pyuo, Yake panda dokona yulu renge palenge mende namwa pyuo lasaka pipili yaka leyami.

Dopa leyaminyipape baame nakama suu pyao kareyami doko soo gisapala dopa lamaiya. Rara mendakindeme liti pipala yango sukusa yanda pirami ramo doko rara doko waiya lao otarasa pira. Dee akalyanda liti mendeme paka lakyuo yango palyuo pira ramo doko waiya lao isa para.

Dokona suu pyao Sataneme baa range paka lakyuo karara ramo doko banya isingi yulu doko apa pyuo palu palyuo parase? Dokona lao nakamame namba kando, Belesapulumi nyisapyamopa imambu koo dupwa raka lanyi nembo karene, letaminyi.

Belesapulu namba nyisapyamosa imambu koo dupwa raka lanyi nembo kararo ramo doko nakamana wambu dupwa apimi nyisilyamopa imambu koo dupwa raka lanyi nembo karengese? Dokona suu pyao pii lalaminyi kandapi doko kinyi panda kyambo lao nakamana wambu dupwa kando makande pyuo selapape.
Doko Anatunya porainya renge dokome minyapyamopa nambame imambu koo dupwa raka lanyi nembo karenge dokona Anatunya isingi yulu doko nakama keta ipyasa pilyamo.
Akali porai mendeme yanda walakape minyuo banya anda rapu pyuo karara dokopa banya bange keyange dupwa kapa mee sera.
Kapa seramopape akali kama porai mendeme epo baa pyao isa palyapala dokopa banya yanda kaku konambepe retaro kararamo dupwa nyepala banya pinjale bange nyuo wambu yango mokwa soo maira.

Mendeme nambana nyiso piso karo pii nara ramo doko nambapa sisu nyuo kararasa pira. Mendeme nambapa role pyao kara napala wambu sukusa nyuo kara nara ramo doko baa wambu bolombalo lao pena lao kararasa pira.
Imambu Koome Palyuo Paramo Anda Dee Range Epara

Imambu koo mende akali mende yaki nyuo papala dokopa yuu lapo ipwa epa nange dupwana anja paliru lao koto papira. Papyuo panda kando nyii napala, Nambana anda yaki nyepala ipu dokona kapu kyuo dee parole lara.
Lapala epo anda doko burumi manjisi bange dupwa rolae soo piramo kandara.

Dokopa papala imambu yanda ipingi nyero baa dopale daa, ama koo wakasa dusipa lanyuo dokona kolando pao palirami. Dokopa akali doko wambo koo ingyuo kareyamo dopale ingyuo kara nara, enakana ama koo wakasa ingyuo karara leya.
Wambu Anatunya Pii Warombo Singi Dupwa Rae Maingi
Pii dopa lao kareyamo dokopa enda mende wambu rukuraka pyuo peteyami dokona sukusa peteyandeme pii ketae palyuo lao dopa leya. Endame emba manjo nyuo anju joo peteyamo dokona elyape keta pisamo leya.
Leyamopape baa dopa lamaiya. Pii letene doko rolae daa. Wambu Anatunya pii warombo soo pisipala pyuo karaminyi dupwa keta renge keyange palamo leya.
Lapome Yesu Wambumi Pinya Saka Nange Yulu Mende Pinya Leyami

Wambu malu rukuraka pyuo peteyami dokona lapo kondo konda pyuo epo buu minyiyami dokopa baame dopa lamaiya. Wambu epapu karaminyi dupwa koo ingyuo karaminyi. Namba kando Anatunya yulu pilipi lao wambumi pii nange yulu mende pii lao makande pyuo letaminyi. Doko pii naronopape Jonana yulu piyamo dokona mana nyelapape.
Anatumi Jona keta kongwalu piyamopa Ninepa wambu dupwa mana nyiyami doko suu pyao wambu epapu isa ando karaminyi dupwa namba Ikinyingi Akali keta Anatu mende piramo soo nyerami.

Kote pii andake paliramo yuu gii dokopa Kuini donorena range baame wambu epapu isa ando karaminyi dupwa kando isipyara ingilyamo. Kuini enda doko banya yuu range nanesa doko yaki nyepala yuu kipwa kipwa dupwana kata londeta epo Solomena pii keyange doko sela epeya. Epapu mendeme Solomonepa manda manji napyamo doko kamame wakasa ingilyamo doko dae kata kande.

Kote pii andake paliramo gii dokopa Ninepa akali dupwame sipurapala dae wambu dupwa kando koo piyami lao kote larami ingilyamo. Dokona lao Joname boo pyao lao kareyamo dokopa Ninepa wambu dupwame banya pii sepala mona enenge palyuo kareyami. Doko mende Jona dokona suu pyao kamame wakasa ingilyamo doko dae kata kande leya.
Yanga Paupau Lenge Dokona PiiLapo Leya

Mendeme lambe kaipala anda isarena iminjingi panda dokona reta naope dee penge dokome nee pyuo pisa naope pingi. Dopa pyuo yalu pii napala rate dokona ketae retenge dokopa wambu andakare eparami dupwame isare doko kapa kando epenale lao pingi.

Embena lenge doko rangena yongona lambe dopale rao karamo. Dokona embena lenge doko mondo lao rao karara ramo doko yongo peparae yangaramopa piso karo piri. Lenge doko kwaeyara ramo doko yanenge peparae iminjaramopa karare.
Dokona yangapyamo karene doko monarena iminja nana lao waso karape.
Embena yongo peparae yanga paupau laramopa dokome kuki lamape iminja nara ramo doko lambe keyange rao dokopa yanenge peparaena yanganyi peenge dopale ingyuo paresa pira leya.
Yesumi Parisi Dupwape Mana Lenge Dupwape Kando Koo Pilyaminyi Leya
Yesu pii lao kareyamo dokopa Parisi akali mendeme baa nenge role pyao nambanale epena leya. Leyamopa andakare pao peteyambi.
Parisi akali dokome Yesu nenge nalana dokopa kingi wate pii napyalyamo lao kandapala mona nembeya.
Dokopa Kamongo dokome baa dopa lamaiya. Nakama Parisi dupwame kapope disipi dupwa netarename iki wate pingi. Nakamana monarename panga soope waa nyingipi yulu koo pingipi dupwa palyuo simbulyamo.
Nakama kopyali karaminyi. Nakamana yanenge pyuo wasiyamo dokome mona doko opetae wasa nayase?
Dokona ingyuo monana koko palenge dupwa wambu dupwa maiyuo karalapape. Dopa pirami ramo dokopa bange peparae elyape sakara lyakande.

Parisi dupwa nakama randa narami ingilyamo. Dokona lao mokwame yokope kyalya yokope nenge nenge yoko wakale wakale dupwa peparaena akalisa silyamo dokona mendaki larapu Anatu pingyu maingi. Mailyaminyi doŋo yulu rolaepe Anatu mona retengepe kaelyaminyi. Yulu doloma kae napala yulu keyange doko opetae pyuo kararaminde pimi.

Parisi akali dupwa nakama randa narami ingilyamo. Dokona lao sinakoke anda dupwana isa petenge mupwa dupwana pisimwali yaka lao suu pyao karaminyi. Nenge ropo pingi kamapi dupwana karo wambu dupwame nakama yako lamili lao suu pyao karaminyi.
Nakama randa narami ingilyamo. Dokona lao yanyanda nee pyuo silyamopa akali lapome yanyandalyamo lao suu pyao nao kamenge ketae dokona kata penge nakama Parisi dupwa dopale ingilyamo leya.
Mawa Pii singi akali dokona mendeme baa dopa lao lamaiya. Mana Lenge, embame dopa lalene doko namwa opetae lao nembapisa pipya leya.
Leyamo Yesumi, Mawa Pii singi akali dupwa nakama opetae randa narami ingilyamoko. Akali bange kenda maiminyi randa nao soo puminyipape nakamame kingi pambu dokomepe nyiso minya nalyaminyi.
Nakama randa narami ingilyamo. Dokona lao nakamana rakange kyawa dupwame Anatunya pyongo piyamopa nolako lao kareyami akali dupwa nyuo pyao kumakayami dupwana malu anda nakamame mondo lao pyakamingi.
Rakange kyawa dupwame pyao kumakayaminyipa nakamana malu anda mondo pilyaminyi dokome nakamana rakange kyawa dupwame kopetame pyuo kareyami doko lyakai pilyamo.
Dokona lao Anatunya pii rolae dopa leya. Nambame poropeta akali lapope aposele akali lapope nakama kararaminyi dokona pena lakamironopa nakama dokona lapo pyao kumakao randa maiyuo pyuo kararami.
Dokona isa panda wasiyamo gii dokona piso epo poropeta akali dupwa peparaena ranjama kulimbwapa piyami dokona epapu isa ando karaminyi dupwa keta kote pii palira.

Akali Epolo piyamo dokona piso epo kama enakana Sakarayame Anatu bange kiso maingi rara singi pakirena tembole anda angi singi kanya dokona piyaminyipa kumuya dokona ranjama dupwa peparaena epapu isa ando karaminyi dupwa keta kote sera lao nakama kinyi langilyu.

Nakama Mawa Pii singi akali dupwa randa epara ingilyamo. Singinya renge anda dokona kii ikyane doko retaro karaminyi. Nakama kolando paa napala wambu kolando panya lao kareyami dupwa kaena lao daa lao kareyami, leya.
Yesu baa yuu doko yaki nyuo panya piyamo dokopa Mawa Pii mana lenge akali dupwape Parisi dupwapeme baa piso sokondali pyuo pii malu lapyali lao angalye piyami.
Baa pii koo kote laramali mende larape lao lyakaro iso kareyami.
